This course builds a foundation in how to use AI agents to build a variety of artifacts, such as websites, writing, images, animations, music, PDFs, data visualizations, and slide decks. Students will develop the professional engineering skills — version control with Git and GitHub, testing, continuous integration, and deployment with GitHub Pages — that make agentic work sustainable and reliable. Each week pairs a concept taught in class with a new artifact to build, along with new skills for working with agents, including managing context and tokens, writing agent skills, calling other AI models through APIs, and keeping data separate from the artifacts it ends up in. The course ends with an individual final project of students’ own design. Students will leave with transferable workflow skills, the judgment to know when and how to verify AI output, and the ability to use AI tools to teach themselves new domains to tackle harder problems.
